About McReg Analytics

We are speed. We are McReg. KAAA-CHOW!

Who we are

McReg Analytics is a data analytics company based in Ortigas, Pasig City, offering swift, efficient services to customers and striving to create a bigger, brighter future. We guarantee professional, reliable services by transforming raw data into useful information that enables smarter decision-making.

Our team is highly competent, qualified, and dedicated to providing precise analytics. All information shared with McReg Analytics is handled with the utmost discretion and confidentiality, processed securely, and used only for its intended purpose.

Our story

McReg Analytics began with a simple mission: to bring order to data, and to see every project through to the finish so we earn good grades in our academic requirements. Along the way it became something more.

01 Car registration

Our team was first founded to oversee the records of a car registration company, where we learned to manage large volumes of structured data with care.

02 Adventure Works Cycles

For a bicycle manufacturer and retailer, we built complete dashboards from raw tables, turning scattered transactions into clear insight on sales, products, and customers.

03 Video games

Having proven our craft in automotive and retail, we are now expanding into one of the most dynamic industries in the world.

Each project sharpened the same core craft: we collect raw data, shape it into a sound relational model, and present it in a form decision makers can trust.

Our Projects

What McReg has built so far.

McReg Car Registration

McReg is a car registration company based in Ortigas, Pasig City, that offers swift and efficient services to customers. Our company guarantees professional, reliable, and legal services by partnering with the Land Transportation Office (LTO). McReg assures customers that all employees and managers are highly competent, qualified, and dedicated to providing precise aid. In addition, the company aims to ensure that all vehicles registered by McReg operating on the roads of Pasig City are compliant with all car registration procedures. With a strong commitment to provide ease and efficiency for the users, McReg uses a database system to ensure that all data is stored in a reliable location, all of which can perform the basic functions of Adding, Updating, and Deleting pertinent records upon request.

McReg Analytics

Adventure Works Cycles

Adventure Works Cycles, a fictional company from the free database AdventureWorks provided by Microsoft, is determined to continue its success as a manufacturer and distributor of bicycle parts and accessories by selling its products through different channels: directly to primary consumers by Internet Sales and to other businesses by Reseller Sales, encompassing wholesale offers and distribution from its pre-existing network of resellers and distributors.

To support Adventure Works Cycles in translating this data into actionable business direction, our data consulting team, McReg Analytics, is determined to explore the data, design a dashboard, and deliver a business intelligence solution that consolidates performance across channels, regions, and product lines into a single, reliable source of truth for the continued success of the company.

Steamscope

In progress

Gaming now earns more than film and music combined (Culture Correspondent, 2026), and Steam stands at the heart of PC gaming. It is home to tens of thousands of titles and millions of players every single day. Yet behind this storefront lies a surprising gap. Steam does not publish how many copies a game sells or how much it earns. There may be written reports or articles surrounding multiple popular gaming companies across owner estimates, prices, genres, reviews, and achievements. However, there is no single source that brings them together.

This project is our answer to that gap. Using only publicly available data, we apply the full Data Science pipeline that McReg Analytics has typically used to Steam. We will be gathering data, cleaning, combining relevant tables, making dashboards for visualizations, and interpreting findings, revealing what drives a game’s success.
